data.official_name: Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and the Establishment of a Foundation for Trustworthiness
alternate_names: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법
data.description: Korea's first comprehensive AI statute. Establishes a risk-based framework (with a 'high-impact AI' category), mandatory generative and interactive AI transparency obligations (Article 31), safety duties for high-compute AI systems (Article 32), and a national AI policy and governance structure.
data.notes: Status: In force January 22, 2026 (passed National Assembly December 26, 2024; promulgated January 21, 2025 as Act No. 20676; verified as of 2026-11-03). Article 31 requires AI business operators providing products or services using generative AI (including conversational chatbots and virtual companions) to notify users in advance that they are interacting with AI and to label synthetic outputs clearly. MSIT announced an initial administrative-fine guidance/grace period of at least one year from January 2026 to support compliance onboarding.

data.official_name: Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, Etc.
data.description: Korea's foundational network-utilization and cybersecurity-incident-reporting statute, enacted 1986 (Act No. 3848), heavily amended since (most recent amendments effective August 14, 2024 strengthening breach-reporting obligations). Predates and complements PIPA (secid:regulation/pipc.go.kr/pipa) — most personal-information provisions moved to PIPA in the 2020 'Data 3 Laws' reform; this Act still covers ISP obligations, spam/malware provisions, and network breach notification.
